from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# Define the 7 legal cause categories from the task as a Literal type
# to constrain the parser to the required taxonomy.
ValidCategories = Literal[
    '民间借贷纠纷',
    '行政行为 - 行政强制',
    '行政主体 - 劳动和社会保障行政管理（劳动，社会保障）',
    '侵犯公民人身权利，民主权利罪',
    '行政行为 - 行政登记',
    '行政行为 - 行政合同',
    '行政主体 - 司法行政管理（司法行政）'
]

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Represents the extracted information for a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The exact title of the judgment document as provided")
    category: ValidCategories | None = Field(description="The assigned legal cause category from the task's taxonomy")
    reasoning: str | None = Field(description="Brief reasoning or key facts supporting the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates the parsed information for a single document instance."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo] = Field(description="List of documents parsed from the input")

from typing import Literal
